source: Selected fields from CLI JSON output
coverageNote: Budget: 80 items. The capture contains 80 open items and omits 40 referenced items. It is not a complete repository inventory. Heat ranks discussion signals, not severity. Queries read this saved capture without fetching GitHub.

query.command: issue-graph query github:vercel-labs/portless --state open --kind Issue --heat-top 25 --view rank --json --no-open
